title: GitCherryPick integration fixture
description: One snapshot case. Structure only — cross-file checks (seed names, capture resolution, principal keys) are enforced by scripts/validate-fixtures.mjs, which validates against this schema first.

name.description: Human label. Becomes the Go subtest name.

description.description: Why this case exists and which ADR it encodes. A fixture nobody can explain is a fixture nobody can safely change, so this is required and cannot be a stub.

seed.description: Named seed sets loaded before the case. Empty means a bare database.

^_.description: Comment. Ignored by the runner, preserved by -update.

seedSet.description: Closed set. A seed name not listed here does not exist in seed/ and would silently load nothing.

principal.description: Keys from seed/principals.json, plus 'anonymous' (no session) and 'system' (harness-driven, not an HTTP caller).

capture.description: Explicit captures, when the automatic ^[a-z_]+_id$ rule is not enough. Values are JSONPath rooted at $.

method.description: HTTP verbs, plus harness pseudo-methods that drive the evaluator, the clock, and the daily jobs. A pseudo-method is not an endpoint and must never appear in the routing table.

propertyNames.description: A table name, or a _-prefixed comment.

db.description: SQL assertions for state the API does not return — standing, link status, cooldown tier.

same_value.description: Columns that must hold the same value across every matched row — e.g. a rotated session family sharing one family_id.

set.description: Absolute. Pins the clock to an instant.

advance.description: Relative, as a Go-style duration with a day unit — '28d', '7d1h'. One form only: 'advance_days: 15' and 'advance: 15d' would be two spellings of one idea.

fake.description: Fake-adapter state for this step. Every external dependency is an interface (ADR-0001), so a fixture states the facts it needs and nothing is fetched.
